name: Unphased skill-line patch follows initial and learned spell packets
contract: Issue #1509: Unphased 803645 belongs to SkillLine 53 (Infernal), while Totemic Smash 501056 stays in SkillLine 41. The client classifies spells from SkillLineAbility rows, not SMSG_INITIAL_SPELLS or SMSG_LEARNED_SPELL. The 0x0934 patch must therefore be resent after the initial spell list and after each learn announcement, including a relog after the spell was learned, so the client never files the new spell under General.

steps.label: Unphased has its authored Infernal row
Totemic Smash keeps its original server and client row
the Infernal row follows the first initial spell list
outlast the 5s login fallback stream so only the learn resend can satisfy the ordering assertion below
the Infernal row follows the learn announcement
the learned resend still carries the authored Infernal row
the Infernal row follows the relog initial spell list
the relog stream still carries the authored Infernal row
